issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders has a type mismatch between the exercise specification and the reference solution. The UML in problem_statement.md declares SealSaloon.-totalOrders: int (problem_statement.md line 28), while the reference implementation declares private long totalOrders = 0; (solution SealSaloon.java line 6). This inconsistency can confuse students about which type to use (int vs long) and whether they must update the getter signature or related code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across specification and implementation. Either update the UML/problem statement to declare totalOrders: long, or change the reference implementation to use an int (private int totalOrders = 0) and update the getTotalOrders() method to return int. Ensure any tests and documentation are updated to match the chosen type.
